thane.desc: Forge-Thane Ragna Copperbraid (dwarf smith-queen): copper-red beard in three braids with gold rings, deep-green wool tunic, wide leather belt with a copper buckle, brown trousers, heavy black boots, smith's hammer sceptre

runewarden.desc: Sereth Gloamweave (dark-elf rune-warden): slate-blue skin, white jaw-length hair, long ears, high-collared charcoal blouse, cold-blue sash, slim black trousers, soft brown boots, a rune-lens on a gold chain, white rune tattoo on the cheek

hushed.desc: Captain Ilvar Hushblade (dark elf, captain of the Hushed): ash-grey skin, silver topknot, long ears, fitted black wrap-top, grey sash, dark trousers bound at the shins, two short blades at his hips, cold-blue rune tattoo

dwarftrader.desc: Brokk Emberlode (dwarf trader): soot-black beard in two braids with brass beads, rust wool shirt, leather apron belted over slate trousers, brown boots

tinker.desc: Tansy Brasswhistle (gnome tinker): tiny red white-spotted toadstool cap, brass goggles, mustard shirt, brown corduroy shorts with braces and a dark belt, striped socks, black shoes

minerunner.desc: Kesh (dark-elf kid, mine-runner): slate-blue skin, messy white hair, long ears, too-big grey knitted jumper, rope belt, short brown trousers, sooty knees, a cave orb in a jar

poolkeeper_sv.desc: Old Haldis (dwarf grandmother): white bun and one long white beard braid, lavender cardigan (periwinkle palette) over a cream blouse, dark skirt with a cream apron tied at the waist, brown shoes, a fishing net

dw1.desc: Anvildeep dwarf smith (ambient): auburn beard in two braids with copper rings, blue tunic, dark leather apron, dark belt, stone trousers, black boots

dw2.desc: Anvildeep dwarf woman (ambient): golden bun and braided golden beard with copper rings, cream shirt under a moss vest, dark belt, brown trousers, red-brown boots

sv1.desc: Svartalf rune-carver (ambient): ash-grey skin, long white hair, long ears, deep-blue wrap-top, cold-blue sash, slim dark trousers, brown soft boots, rune tattoo

sv2.desc: Svartalf miner (ambient): slate-blue skin, silver bun, long ears, wine-red wrap-top, pale sash, slim slate trousers, black shoes, white rune tattoo
